study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dynamic gray matter volume changes in pediatric multiple sclerosis: A 3.5 year MRI study

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: HSR healthy controls (26) from a single site; NIH-funded MRI Study of Normal Brain Development healthy controls (317)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "(1) a group of 26 sexand age-matched HC recruited at Hospital San Raffaele (HSR)... and (2) a group of 317 pediatric HC from the NIH-funded MRI Study of Normal Brain Development (NIH HC)"

answer.SINGLE-SITE: baseline comparison healthy controls on same scanner as patients

answer.NIHPD: normative GM developmental trajectory estimation (longitudinal HC)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HSR HC used for comparison at baseline on same scanner; NIH HC used to estimate GM developmental trajectories for normative z scores
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "a group of 26 sexand age-matched HC recruited at Hospital San Raffaele (HSR)... studied on the same MRI scanner as patients with MS at baseline; and (2) a group of 317 pediatric HC from the NIH-funded MRI Study of Normal Brain Development (NIH HC) with longitudinal MRI assessments for brain volume quantification"; "a group of 317 pediatric HC from an NIH-funded MRI Study of Normal Brain Development was used to estimate GM developmental trajectories"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: DeMeo2019.pdf.md: Methods / Participants; DeMeo2019.pdf.md: Abstract / Methods

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: HC cohort combines HSR HC (26) and NIH HC (317) used for HC developmental trajectories
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "a group of 26 sexand age-matched HC... and (2) a group of 317 pediatric HC from the NIH-funded MRI Study of Normal Brain Development (NIH HC)"; "GMvolume developmental trajectories as estimated in all HC"
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: DeMeo2019.pdf.md: Methods / Participants; DeMeo2019.pdf.md: HC developmental trajectories

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD computed from HSR HC mean age 15.4 (SD 3.8; n=26) and NIH HC mean age 10.8 (SD 3.7; n=317). Min/max inferred from NIH HC age range 4.2 to 22.3 years.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "Mean age, y (SD) | 15.4 (3.8) | 10.8 (3.7)"; "aged from 4.2 years at the first MRI scan up to 22.3 years at the last MRI scan"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Totals computed from HSR HC female/male 15/11 and NIH HC female/male 166/151.
